title: Buy crypto
description: Choose the best way to fund your account or buy crypto.
serverQuoteDescription: Your exact rate, fee and received amount will be locked before confirmation.
rateNotice: The server validates ownership, limits, balance and the final rate. A financial order is never applied optimistically.
depositWarning: Only deposit from a bank account verified in your name.

quote.title: Review purchase
quote.description: Review the server-issued quote before confirming. The quote cannot be modified by the browser.
quote.expired: This quote has expired. Request a fresh quote to continue.

order.pending: Your purchase was accepted and is being processed.
order.completed: Your purchase is complete and your balance has been refreshed.
order.failed: The purchase could not be completed. No duplicate order will be created when you retry safely.

errors.network: The order status could not be confirmed. Check your connection and try again; the same request key prevents a duplicate purchase.
errors.unexpected: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.QUOTE_EXPIRED: The quote expired. Request a fresh quote.
errors.QUOTE_NOT_FOUND: This quote is unavailable. Request a fresh quote.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Your available balance is insufficient for this purchase.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This purchase exceeds your current account limit.
errors.PURCHASE_BLOCKED: This purchase cannot be completed for this account. Contact support if you need help.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many purchase requests were sent. Wait a moment and try again.
